User.title: User
User.description: User profile in Apna Tambola with MLM referral attributes and wallet balances

id.description: Unique user identifier (e.g. AT123456 or USR-101)

email.description: Unique email address for authentication and notices

referralCode.description: Unique referral code for sharing (e.g. APNA100)

referredBy.description: User ID of the upline sponsor/referrer. Atomically assigned during registration transaction.

sponsorName.description: Display name of the upline sponsor

directReferralsCount.description: Count of direct Level 1 downline members

ticketWallet.description: Ticket wallet balance for buying tickets

winningWallet.description: Winning wallet balance eligible for withdrawal

referralEarnings.description: Total commission earned across 8 referral levels

directIncomeEarnings.description: Direct referral signup bonuses and incentives

role.description: User access role: user or admin

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp of account registration

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp of last profile update

/users/{userId}.description: Master collection of user profiles with referral relationships and downline stats
